fields.statement: At bdc764ab3 (attempt 2): go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestPickNoLeaves|TestDaemonPicks|TestConductorWorkflow' ok; -run 'TestDaemon|TestPick|TestConductor|TestReadyWorkflow|TestStartWorkflow|TestUmbrella' ok; go vet ./internal/api clean; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-ship-needs-leaves ok; -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-picks|run-ship)' ok. TestPickNoLeaves dispatches a leafless milestone change set through the real [ready] rule and changeConducts: picked for an agent-with-checks workflow, no-leaves skip for a leaves-first one, backlog still no-leaves, umbrella not-ready. The script refuses a leafless change set under a command-step ship-change with 'has no leaves' and next 'rhiza run start --workflow plan', then runs it to success under a conductor ship-change with fake bin/claude and bin/rex. Diff: conductorWorkflow/changeConducts in daemon.go, Conducts wired in daemon_fold.go, run.go guard; no TODOs.
